description: Validate that a user can log in using GitHub OAuth and access their dashboard.
steps: Verify that the GitHub sign-in option is visible and enabled.
Click on the GitHub sign-in button.
Verify that the GitHub login page is displayed.
Enter valid GitHub credentials (username and password) on the GitHub login page.
Click the 'Sign In' or 'Authorize' button on the GitHub login page.
Verify that the user is redirected back to the Roost application.
Check that the user lands on their dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai and sees relevant data.
expected_results: The user is authenticated via GitHub OAuth.
The user is redirected to the dashboard page at https://dev.roost.ai.
edge_cases: User denies authorization on the GitHub login page.
Session timeout occurs before authentication is completed.
data_requirements: Valid GitHub OAuth client ID and redirect URI.
dependencies: GitHub OAuth service must be operational.
Roost backend must handle OAuth tokens correctly.
The user's GitHub account must be active and in good standing.
api_interactions: Roost API to fetch user-specific data after login.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect back to the dashboard after login.
Page load time for the dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the GitHub sign-in button is keyboard accessible.
Verify that screen readers can announce the GitHub sign-in option.
Ensure color contrast ratios meet WCAG standards for the sign-in button.
Verify that focus order is logical and intuitive.
